prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity decision comp for the real Dun installed timer app, one portrait app viewport.
Primary request: Create a polished, credible flat UI screenshot of Dun's Timers screen. Direction: "Interval instrument", inspired by sports stopwatches and interval timers. The interface itself fills the entire image, one portrait frame, approximately 480 by 800 logical pixels, render sharply at high resolution in this 3:5 aspect ratio. No device frame and no outside scene.
Structure, in order, with timer faces dominating:
1. Compact top header, about 40 logical pixels high: "Dun" on the left, a small recognizable settings gear at right.
2. Straight horizontal three-tab navigation, about 40 pixels high: "Timers" selected with a strong teal underline, followed by "Reminders" and "History".
3. Dominant expired timer face for "Eggs", about 205 pixels high, broad red flat panel. Very large bold tabular "0:00" is the biggest text on the entire screen, with clear "Time's up" beneath. Strong high-contrast status and urgency. Below the face, three substantial rectangular controls labeled "Done", "Snooze", "Restart"; Done is the obvious primary completion control. Use white text on the red face and a white or pale primary Done control with ink text.
4. "Pomodoro" running timer face, about 150 pixels high. A large familiar circular countdown progress dial on the left, visible teal arc around a neutral track, tabular "17:24" centered in it. The timer title and "Running" status are on the right, followed by substantial rectangular "Pause" and "Reset" controls. Make the count large and readable; dial does not overwhelm the numeral.
5. "Bread proof" paused timer face, about 150 pixels high. Same stable layout as Pomodoro: circular progress dial with a restrained ink or neutral arc, very large tabular "38:00", title "Bread proof", clear "Paused" status, substantial rectangular "Resume" and "Reset" controls.
6. Lower "New timer" setter, about 150 pixels high. Clear grouped hours, minutes, seconds fields, showing "00 : 05 : 00" with tiny useful labels "Hours", "Minutes", "Seconds". A broad rectangular primary control "Start timer". Under it a compact row of practical quick-preset controls: "Tea 4m", "Pomodoro 25m", "Laundry 45m".
Visual system: cool gray #E9EEF1 app ground, deep ink #162B37 text and edges, #287D87 teal for running activity and primary actions, #DA462F expiry red. Crisp flat panel faces, thin deliberate rules, precise geometric spacing, minimal corner radius of 3 to 5 pixels on controls, no soft shadows. Robust modern sans-serif with very strong tabular numerals, practical athletic instrument clarity. Timer countdowns must be the largest elements by far, titles and controls confidently readable. Respect ample touch targets and balanced whitespace while fitting this exact single portrait first viewport.
Text is verbatim: "Dun", "Timers", "Reminders", "History", "Eggs", "0:00", "Time's up", "Done", "Snooze", "Restart", "Pomodoro", "17:24", "Running", "Pause", "Reset", "Bread proof", "38:00", "Paused", "Resume", "New timer", "00", "05", "Hours", "Minutes", "Seconds", "Start timer", "Tea 4m", "Pomodoro 25m", "Laundry 45m".
Constraints: Actual app screenshot, fully designed and finished, not a wireframe. Traditional functional timer UI, prominent countdowns and immediate urgency. Real product content only. Do not add marketing, slogans, claims, statistics, dates, extra timers, extra navigation, decorative illustrations, device photos, scenery, pseudo-3D, gradients, glows, perspective, glossy effects, watermarks, or text outside the app viewport.
